title: The books most often copied among the Dead Sea Scrolls
description: Bar chart of the number of manuscripts of each book identified among the Dead Sea Scrolls, for the eight most copied: Psalms 39, Deuteronomy 33, 1 Enoch 25, Genesis 24, Isaiah 22, Jubilees 21, Exodus 18, Leviticus 17. 1 Enoch and Jubilees, highlighted, are outside the later Jewish canon. Data: Wikipedia, Dead Sea Scrolls, after VanderKam and Flint.
heading: COPIES FOUND AT QUMRAN · MOST-COPIED BOOKS
